transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in today?

I came in because my mind keeps going blank, especially at work. I’ll be looking at the road-closure forms, or even holding the stop-slow paddle, and suddenly I can’t remember the steps I’ve done for years. It’s been happening at the worst times, and it’s really worrying me.
Have you experienced any confusion, disorientation, or trouble recognizing familiar places or people along with your memory issues?

It’s mostly like my thinking just stops or blanks out. I’ll be at work looking at the road-closure forms, or holding the stop-slow paddle, and suddenly I can’t remember the steps I’ve done for years. That’s the part that scares me.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?
Yes. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy, hollow sadness in my chest. It feels like the day is already ruined before I even get out of bed.
